descriptionHtml:
Attack Shark R1 Tri-Mode Wireless Ultra-Lightweight Gaming Mouse - White Edition

Accelerate your tracking execution and secure flawless target acquisition with the ultra-light Attack Shark R1 Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse in Pure Clean White. Available at Turbo Computer, this highly efficient PC hardware gaming peripheral is masterfully engineered for competitive esports players, tactical FPS shooters, and active digital website managers across Egypt who demand swift flick adjustments, zero cable dragging, and an incredibly light 59-gram chassis blueprint. Armed with high-tier tracking specifications including advanced DPI control, rapid IPS matrix limits, and high-frame capacity tracking, this white edition is backed by an official 1-year warranty for full peace of mind.

The Attack Shark R1 is powered by the precise PixArt PAW3311 optical gaming sensor matrix, capable of delivering a staggering resolution scaling up to 18,000 DPI combined with a blistering tracking speed velocity of 400 IPS and an ultra-responsive 40G acceleration rate framework. Working in perfect unison with a high-grade BK3633 tri-mode connectivity engine, it gives you the freedom to switch instantly between Bluetooth, lag-free 2.4GHz wireless, and reliable Type-C wired modes. Engineered with built-in Smart Sleep power-saving features, its optimized battery framework delivers up to 65 hours of non-stop high-FPS tracking execution on a single charging cycle. Equipped with heavy-duty microswitches rated for 20-million crisp clicks, this mouse delivers absolute click consistency during intense competitive runs.
